login.title: Sign in to your account
login.totp_instructions: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.magic_link_instructions: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a link to sign in.
login.magic_link_sent: Check your inbox. We sent a sign-in link to {email}.

avatar.label: Profile picture
avatar.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF. Max 5 MB.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.disabled_description: Two-factor authentication adds an extra step when you sign in. Once enabled, you'll need a 6-digit code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
totp.enabled_description: Two-factor authentication is enabled on this account.
totp.pending_description: An enrollment is in progress but was not completed. Restart setup to get a fresh QR code and secret, or cancel to abandon it.
totp.enroll_instructions: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.recovery_codes_warning: Save these now — they will not be shown again. Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator.
totp.disable_confirm: Enter your password to disable two-factor authentication.
totp.regenerate_confirm: Enter your password to generate a new set of recovery codes. The previous set will stop working.

errors.regenerate_failed: Could not regenerate recovery codes. Please try again.
